questions.question: How many MW of conventional steam coal generators retired in 2025, in the warehouse's table of retired generators?
questions.answer: Conventional Steam Coal generators retired in 2025 totalled 2,626 MW (sum of 8 generators, eia860m_retired_generators, EIA-860M, vintage 2026-09). Nameplate and the table's capacity_mw both give 2,626 MW. By retirement month, in MW: 445.5 in February, 425.9 in March (2 units), 920 in October (3 units), 820 in November and 14.6 in December. Retirement dates are month-start dates in UTC. All 8 coal units in the table are 2025 retirements, and the table has none for 2026.

questions.question: How many conservation appeals did ERCOT issue in 2023, in the warehouse's table of ERCOT's grid notices?
questions.answer: ERCOT issued 8 conservation appeals in 2023, counted as rows with event_type conservation_appeal and status issued (ercot_grid_notices, a public source table). Six are in August 2023 and two in September 2023. They fall on 8 separate local days (America/Chicago): 2023-08-23, 08-24, 08-25, 08-26, 08-28, 08-29, 09-05 and 09-06. All 8 come from ERCOT news releases. The table also holds 4 notices of a separate type, voluntary_conservation, in 2023. I did not add those to the count.
